text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (I don't get it at aaaaaall!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how I look at it, Brian-san and 
Pearl-san are going in completely 
different directions, aren't they?! Why 
does Brian-san respect them?)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Why did she say she wanted to try playing 
with the two of them? Why would 
Brian-san...)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...She smiled, as if Maya just didn't get 
it.

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaahhh?! Seriously~~~~?! 
...Heeey, Pearl, Pearl~!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —We're filling in for the live show?!

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The band on the joint bill just 
canceled at the last second! 
...Could you guys step in for them?

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We'll do it!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaaaat?! W-Wait up! 
Our songs totally don't match the vibe 
here, or like—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Our band is surely unexpected! 
Which means we can deliver an unforeseen 
wave of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meaaan! The audience 
here 
came to see a cool band—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Still, what we need to do doesn't change, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san. I've finished adjusting the 
drums. 
Also, I seem to have forgotten my comedy 
props...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
OK, we'll work with what we've got! Let's 
borrow some gear from the owner, too! 
Mayano, get ready for standby, please.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(...Why? Why are they so confident? 
The vibe isn't promising at all. Why are 
they trying so hard—)

text_block_list.name: Live House Owner
text_block_list.text:
This band's on their last song. 
You guys should head backstage soon.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mayano. We're about to take the 
stage, but... 
...make sure to take a good look at them, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Take a look... at what?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Their faces. All kinds of faces have 
gathered here. 
—Yes, the audience who is waiting for us!!

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, our 'Destiny Revolution Mandate' 
isn't playing~?! 
Guess I'll go grab a drink...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(This is totally enemy territory, isn't 
it~?!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um, Pearl-san. 
Maybe today really isn't—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed, the crowd gathered here is unique 
to this very day.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
People who don't know us, people who 
vaguely recognize us as Tracen Academy 
students, 
secret fans... and—

text_block_list.name: First-Time Concertgoer
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what the next band is going to 
be like...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—even people experiencing a band show for 
the very first time and feeling lost.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, every single one of them is 
waiting for fun. 
Because they came here to be an 
"audience."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then all we have to do is welcome them 
with everything we've got! 
—...Come on, Fuku—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a cat? Is that a cat? 
No, wait... is that... a cat...?

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer A
text_block_list.text:
And she's sitting at the drum kit. 
Don't tell me she's gonna drum like that—

text_block_list.name: Band Audience Member
text_block_list.text: THEY  P R O U T E D !

text_block_list.name: Concertgoer B
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... You're just gonna punch right 
through it?! 
What was the point of wearing it in the 
first place?!

text_block_list.name: First-Time Concertgoer
text_block_list.text: Hehe... chucle...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Now, brace yourselves! 
Everyone who came today!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This game won't end until we make every 
last one of you laugh! 
—Now, let's play!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: (—And then, the music began.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Fukukitaru-san was wearing a cardboard 
box as usual. 
And Pearl-san was trying to pull out a 
tuna-shaped guitar case again.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Not at all. It wasn't cool at all, not 
even a little bit.)

text_block_list.name: First-Time Concertgoer
text_block_list.text: Hehe—Ahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —...COME ON! TUNA—!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(The stage lights, the sweat, the 
glare—everything looked so sparkling.)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
—Giving it their all... purely, simply 
giving it everything they had.
